title: Tenant history: how long they have stayed, and every room they have stayed in
description:
User request: opening a tenant should show their history - how long they have been living here, in which room, and whether they have moved beds.

HALF OF THIS ALREADY EXISTS and should be built on rather than replaced. The notes and timeline screen (LODGY-25) already assembles itself from what the warden does: it shows recorded credits, room moves and manual notes against dates. The tenancy also already carries move-in, move-out and status, so 'how long' is derivable today without any new data.

WHAT IS MISSING is the stay itself as a first-class thing: a clear 'living here since 4 Sep 2026, 3 months' rather than the warden reading a date and doing the arithmetic, and the sequence of beds they have occupied. The bed sequence needs LODGY-91 - today the app only knows their current bed, and the moves survive only as English sentences in the notes table.

WHERE IT GOES: the tenant profile, near the identity block, since 'how long have you been with me' is something a warden answers while looking at the person. The detail belongs on the existing timeline rather than in a second, competing history screen - two places showing overlapping history will drift apart.

A REAL CASE TO DESIGN FOR: a tenant disputing a rent increase, or asking for their deposit back, will say 'I have been here two years'. The warden needs the answer on screen while that conversation is happening, not after opening three screens. Equally, a returning tenant - one who left and came back - has more than one tenancy, and the screen should show that as two stays rather than silently showing only the latest.

Depends on LODGY-91 for the bed sequence. The duration and stay summary could ship before it if the PO wants the smaller half sooner.
acceptanceCriteria: The tenant profile states how long they have been living here, in words a warden would use, not just a move-in date
Every bed and room they have occupied is listed in order, with the dates they were there
A tenant who has left and returned shows as separate stays, not as one merged period or only the most recent
A tenant who has never moved reads naturally, without an empty or one-item 'history' section that looks broken
It uses the existing timeline for detail rather than introducing a second history screen that could disagree with it
A checked-out tenant keeps their full history, consistent with delete and checkout never destroying the past
Correct for a shop, warehouse or flat, where the stay is of the whole property and there is no bed to name
Correct in Hindi as well as English, including the duration wording

history.note: Filed from a user request. Blocked on LODGY-91 for the bed sequence; the duration half is buildable today. Deliberately scoped to extend the existing timeline rather than add a rival history screen.

LODGY-94 has been filed so the warden can enter past stays themselves. It matters to this ticket because without it this screen opens blank for every stay that predates the feature - which for an existing warden is most of them - and the empty state would be the normal case rather than the exception. Worth designing the empty state on the assumption that backfill exists and may or may not have been used.
Starting, on top of LODGY-91's occupancy_periods table (now built, in Testing).

Built: stay duration on TenantProfileScreen ('Living here since X - 3 months' / 'Lived here from X - 3 months'), derived from the latest TenancyAgreement (TenantProfileViewModel.stayDuration, no new data needed) via a new reusable ui/common/DurationLabel.kt (durationValue is a pure, tested bucketing function; durationLabel is the thin @Composable wrapper). Room history: NotesTimelineViewModel now also observes OccupancyPeriodRepository.observeStaysByTenantId (new live DAO query joining bed/room/hostel) and groups periods into stays by tenancyAgreementId (null-agreement/backfilled periods each stand alone); NotesTimelineScreen renders a 'Room history' section above the note stream, hidden when a tenant has only ever had one period (never moved). Reuses the existing timeline screen - no new nav destination. Docs: DESIGN.md 4.3 (duration) + 4.6 (room history) + decision log, USER-MANUAL.md (profile + notes-and-timeline sections). Unit tests: DurationLabelTest (pure bucketing logic), NotesTimelineViewModelTest extended (grouping, single-period hiding), TenantProfileViewModelTest extended (active vs closed duration), OccupancyPeriodRepositoryTest extended (observeStaysByTenantId passthrough). Full suite green, coverage above the 0.93 gate - see the combined LODGY-91/92/93 build numbers on LODGY-93's handoff note. assembleDebug succeeds. Not verified on-device for the same reason noted on LODGY-91/94: no working emulator this session.
See LODGY-91's comment at 2026-09-17T15:50:00Z - the device migration verification flagged on all four of LODGY-91/92/93/94 is done, on a populated database, with no data loss and no crash.

PASS - verified on-device. Duration wording correct for both an active tenancy ("Living here since 1 Sep 2024 - 2 year(s)") and a closed one ("Lived here from 17 Sep 2026 - Today"). Room history hidden for a tenant with only one period (checked before any transfer). After a transfer, tested a genuine returning-tenant scenario (one app-recorded stay + one backfilled stay with no agreement) and the timeline correctly showed two separate stay cards, most recent first, exactly per DESIGN.md 4.6 - not merged, not only-the-latest. A checked-out tenant's profile keeps full contact info and duration wording (nothing hidden by VACATED status). Reuses the existing Notes & Timeline screen, no new nav route added. Hindi string coverage confirmed complete (every new key in values/strings.xml has a values-hi counterpart). Shop/warehouse/flat wording not re-tested live (reuses the existing, already-tested BedLocation.label() utility from LODGY-79/86) - code-reviewed, no new branch introduced for this ticket.

BOUNCE BACK - the room history I actually need is missing for the exact tenant I tried it on. Ramesh Kumar moved from Room 101 Bed A to Room 102 Bed A before this feature existed (his old free-text note still says so on the same screen); I used LODGY-94 to backfill that old stay so his profile would finally tell the true story. It didn't: the whole Room history section is gone, not just short a row. Root cause (verified in code, not just behavior): NotesTimelineViewModel.showStays only turns on when the tenant has MORE THAN ONE occupancy_period total (app/src/main/java/com/lodgy/app/ui/note/NotesTimelineViewModel.kt:49, sumOf periods.size > 1). That rule was written for "never moved" but a tenant who moved once before the app existed, and has exactly one backfilled period plus a current tenancy that (correctly, per LODGY-91's decision) has no period of its own, also lands at a period-count of exactly 1 - and gets treated identically to someone who has lived in the same bed since day one. This is not a rare edge case for me: every existing tenant who moved beds even once before I started using this version will hit it the first time I try to backfill just their one prior room, which is the single most common thing I will actually do with LODGY-94. Suggested fix: a lone period should still show if it is backfilled (TenantStayRow doesn't even carry that flag today - the query would need it added), since a backfilled period is itself evidence there is more story than "never moved," unlike a lone app-recorded period. This also directly breaks LODGY-94's own AC3 ("backfilled stays appear in tenant history... exactly like recorded ones") - I'm bouncing that one back too for the same root cause, no need to fix it twice.
